feature_idea: EDI orchestrator role: classify a plain-language request from Adam, select the relevant review-council/persona specialist(s), invoke them, reconcile any conflicting recommendations, and return one synthesized answer with a clear approval status.

invocation_log.note: Drafted from existing charter-matrix/session context rather than a live PM interview; awaiting Adam's confirmation the customer/problem framing is accurate.
7 questions, EXTERNAL mode (Adam as the skeptical requester of his own tooling).
6 questions, INTERNAL mode; 3 flagged BLOCKER (selection mechanism, reconciliation mechanism, runtime architecture) — all must be resolved before Requirements.

All 3 BLOCKERs (selection mechanism, reconciliation mechanism, runtime architecture) and the success-metric OPEN item resolved directly by Adam via one-at-a-time AskUserQuestion decisions on 2026-08-30. Decisions: EDI = Skill/slash-command using Claude Code's native Task tool; reconciliation = escalation-rules gate first, then LLM synthesis pass; selection = LLM reads AGENT-CATALOG.md per request; success metric = matches Adam's manual conclusion, faster. The cost/token overhead open item (single- vs multi-specialist request mix) remains open and deferred, not blocking.
